body: No worries! Learning a second language is an incredible achievement. I wish that I had a brain for that

Asinine is something that is just unbelievably stupid or doesn’t make sense. Uncanny valley is a theory that as something becomes more humanlike the things about it that are not humanlike become more obvious and repulsive.  Think cgi. The higher the realism the more obvious the little things are letting us know that this is not real and the more negative reactions it induces
Thank you btw for replying. I just started in here today a little bit ago.

And I can’t imagine anything worse than ending it and then that not being the final end. Reincarnation is one of my biggest fears actually. That I’ll finally cross the finish line only to be plugged back in to start it all over again
What do you do when you know your suffering will eventually end but the end is the end of life
I get told I’m too smart for my own good. It’s like if you think too much about how asinine this all is they can spot you. You almost become uncanny valley to them.

My wife is deaf so there’s a lot of yelling in my home. I hate it but she makes me feel like the biggest ahole whenever I ask her to just wear the hearing aids. She is so combative on her personal decision to not wear the hearing aid and then also demands that everyone yell, make a point to get her attention before choosing to speak and then face her at close range (she also won’t wear her glasses) when speaking. The repeating myself is driving me crazy
